sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Replace the presence-only checks for bowShapeCoefficient, totalGlancingImpactForce, glancingImpactLineLoad, and glancingImpactPressure with bounded formula-derived constraints that explicitly bind each required area case to the ship's actual bowShape, recompute the expected results from the verified formula operands, and compare reported derived decimals using tolerances scaled from the expected values.
